title: R4 LOADING lane entries (the art director merges them into art/MANIFEST.json by id; arrowGlossy* rows only append a note)

entries.purpose: loading screen (D1 'Burrow Works'): a boarded teal vault under timber arch beams, copper pipes, the yard doorway in warm daylight, the sorting machine (teal iron / brass / copper / timber), the timber dock, sandstone flags, a hemp rope, D1 enamel flying block arrows
entries.notes: R4 LOADING (D1; ruling 46): same composition and object types as the 09-27 backdrop (scene_loading.py stays the geometry source), materials/colours changed. Proofs art/review/loading/ (copygate vs store 8 in proofs.json).

entries.purpose: two small Diggers on the dock at the back left of the Loading screen (the map Digger and the shovel Digger, R2's home-rig renders at ~0.4x, a touch of room haze)
entries.notes: R4 LOADING. Replaces char_workerCrowdLeft's slot in char_loading_layout.json.

entries.purpose: glossy 3D arrow, D1 sunflower (the id's colour word is the pre-D1 name)
